references.text: Joseph's death is described in detail in Genesis 50:26, where it states that he died at the age of 110, was embalmed, and placed in a coffin in Egypt.
Before his death, Joseph prophesied to his brothers that God would lead them out of Egypt and into the promised land.
In his speech, Stephen refers to the deaths of Jacob and the fathers in Egypt, linking this to Israel's history.
Jacob's death is described here; he was gathered to his fathers, illustrating the pattern of generational change.
A reference to an entire generation dying out in the wilderness, paralleling how Joseph's entire generation died out in Egypt.
A similar phrasing is used regarding Joshua's generation that passed away, and a new generation arose who did not know the Lord.
The book of Hebrews mentions Joseph's faith as he was about to die, noting that he spoke concerning the Israelites' departure from Egypt.
Both verses mark the end of an era by the death of a leader and his entire family together.
